comingLast.roast: hide his keys, hide his phone, keep him at the bar
needs 6 from 4 - his playing group has started the commentary
9 from his last 6 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
5 holes between him and a very memorable presso
needs 2 in 2 - the kind of chase the bar was built for
3 to play and the blue balls are already doing warm-down stretches
4 holes of runway left - 3 points clears the fence
2 points buys freedom - Hope is pricing it higher by the minute
on 20 with 4 to go - the blue balls can smell the clubhouse
in with a 1-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
